actual_parser_geometry_review.finding: The active parser output places the em dash more than4pt above its neighboring text in y0 although the SDK glyph origins share a baseline. DOCX row grouping uses y0 with4pt tolerance, so the dash splits into its own row. Native parser segment extraction also trims segment text and drops whitespace-only segments. Need owned regression and a general geometry/space representation fix; no runtime or gold correction made.
